select devices_view.* from (
select dg.licenseId as licenseId, dg.licenseKey as licenseKey, dg.hostname as hostname, dg.usbId as usbId, dg.machineId as machineId, dg.osName as osName, dg.arch as arch, dg.driveFs as driveFs, dg.clientVersion as clientVersion, dg.firstSeenAt as firstSeenAt, case when gw.lastGatewayAt is not null and (dg.deviceLastSeenAt is null or gw.lastGatewayAt > dg.deviceLastSeenAt) then gw.lastGatewayAt else dg.deviceLastSeenAt end as lastSeenAt, dg.launchCount as launchCount, dg.lastIp as lastIp, dg.rawCount as rawCount, coalesce(gw.gatewayStartCount, 0) as gatewayStartCount, coalesce(gw.gatewaySuccessCount, 0) as gatewaySuccessCount, coalesce(gw.gatewayFailedCount, 0) as gatewayFailedCount, gw.lastGatewayAt as lastGatewayAt, gw.lastGatewayEventType as lastGatewayEventType, gw.lastGatewayMessage as lastGatewayMessage from ( select d.license_id as licenseId, max(l.license_key) as licenseKey, d.hostname as hostname, d.usb_id as usbId, substring_index(group_concat(d.machine_id order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as machineId, substring_index(group_concat(d.os_name order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as osName, substring_index(group_concat(d.arch order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as arch, substring_index(group_concat(d.drive_fs order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as driveFs, substring_index(group_concat(d.client_version order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as clientVersion, min(d.first_seen_at) as firstSeenAt, max(d.last_seen_at) as deviceLastSeenAt, coalesce(sum(d.launch_count), 0) as launchCount, substring_index(group_concat(d.last_ip order by d.last_seen_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastIp, count(*) as rawCount from devices d left join licenses l on l.id = d.license_id group by d.license_id, d.usb_id, d.hostname ) dg left join ( select license_id as licenseId, license_key as licenseKey, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.usbId')), 'null'), '') as usbId, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.hostname')), 'null'), '') as hostname, count(*) as gatewayStartCount, sum(case when event_type = 'gateway_start_success' then 1 else 0 end) as gatewaySuccessCount, sum(case when event_type = 'gateway_start_failed' then 1 else 0 end) as gatewayFailedCount, max(created_at) as lastGatewayAt, substring_index(group_concat(event_type order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastGatewayEventType, substring_index(group_concat(message order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastGatewayMessage from client_event where event_type in ('gateway_start_success', 'gateway_start_failed') group by license_id, license_key, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.usbId')), 'null'), ''), nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.hostname')), 'null'), '') ) gw on ( gw.licenseId = dg.licenseId or (gw.licenseId is null and gw.licenseKey = dg.licenseKey) ) and (gw.usbId = dg.usbId or (gw.usbId is null and dg.usbId is null)) and (gw.hostname = dg.hostname or (gw.hostname is null and dg.hostname is null)) union all select gw.licenseId as licenseId, gw.licenseKey as licenseKey, gw.hostname as hostname, gw.usbId as usbId, gw.machineId as machineId, gw.osName as osName, gw.arch as arch, gw.driveFs as driveFs, gw.clientVersion as clientVersion, gw.lastGatewayAt as firstSeenAt, gw.lastGatewayAt as lastSeenAt, gw.gatewayStartCount as launchCount, coalesce(gw.lastIp, ( select d.last_ip from devices d left join licenses l on l.id = d.license_id where ( gw.licenseId = d.license_id or (gw.licenseId is null and gw.licenseKey = l.license_key) ) and (gw.hostname = d.hostname or (gw.hostname is null and d.hostname is null)) and d.last_ip is not null and d.last_ip <> '' order by d.last_seen_at desc limit 1 ), '') as lastIp, 0 as rawCount, gw.gatewayStartCount as gatewayStartCount, gw.gatewaySuccessCount as gatewaySuccessCount, gw.gatewayFailedCount as gatewayFailedCount, gw.lastGatewayAt as lastGatewayAt, gw.lastGatewayEventType as lastGatewayEventType, gw.lastGatewayMessage as lastGatewayMessage from ( select license_id as licenseId, license_key as licenseKey, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.usbId')), 'null'), '') as usbId, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.hostname')), 'null'), '') as hostname, substring_index(group_concat(nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.machineId')), 'null'), '') order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as machineId, substring_index(group_concat(nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.os')), 'null'), '') order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as osName, substring_index(group_concat(nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.arch')), 'null'), '') order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as arch, substring_index(group_concat(nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.driveFs')), 'null'), '') order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as driveFs, substring_index(group_concat(nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.clientVersion')), 'null'), '') order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as clientVersion, substring_index(group_concat(coalesce( nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.ip')), 'null'), ''), nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.clientIp')), 'null'), '') ) order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastIp, count(*) as gatewayStartCount, sum(case when event_type = 'gateway_start_success' then 1 else 0 end) as gatewaySuccessCount, sum(case when event_type = 'gateway_start_failed' then 1 else 0 end) as gatewayFailedCount, max(created_at) as lastGatewayAt, substring_index(group_concat(event_type order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastGatewayEventType, substring_index(group_concat(message order by created_at desc separator '|||'), '|||', 1) as lastGatewayMessage from client_event where event_type in ('gateway_start_success', 'gateway_start_failed') group by license_id, license_key, nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.usbId')), 'null'), ''), nullif(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(details_json, '$.hostname')), 'null'), '') ) gw where not exists ( select 1 from devices d left join licenses l on l.id = d.license_id where ( gw.licenseId = d.license_id or (gw.licenseId is null and gw.licenseKey = l.license_key) ) and (gw.usbId = d.usb_id or (gw.usbId is null and d.usb_id is null)) and (gw.hostname = d.hostname or (gw.hostname is null and d.hostname is null)) )
) devices_view
and devices_view.licenseKey like concat('%', #{licenseKey}, '%')
and devices_view.hostname like concat('%', #{hostname}, '%')
and devices_view.usbId like concat('%', #{usbId}, '%')
and devices_view.lastIp like concat('%', #{lastIp}, '%')
order by devices_view.lastSeenAt desc
